verdict: Ads are delivering strongly; key setup milestones need to close now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns returned $7,538.64 in revenue on $1,381.29 in spend — a 5.46x return on ad spend — and purchase volume jumped 56% week over week, confirming the momentum is real. The top campaign continued to lead that growth and efficiency held firm across the most recent days reviewed. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile averaged strong daily engagement across the period, though activity dropped sharply on October 26–28; we are investigating whether this is a profile or data issue and will have clarity shortly. Several setup milestones — including funnel testing, automation flows, and subscribe pages — are overdue and are being prioritized this week, as completing them will strengthen the infrastructure the ad results are currently running on. With the October 31 scaling milestone approaching, closing those items is the focus heading into next period.
